# telnyx_porting_order_phone_number_extensions (Data Source)

Lists porting order phone number extensions, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_porting_order_phone_number_extension`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `porting_order_id` (String) The porting order id.

### Optional

- `filter_porting_phone_number_id` (String) Filter results by porting phone number id
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort_value` (String) Specifies the sort order for results. If not given, results are sorted by created_at in descending order One of `-created_at`, `created_at`.

### Read-Only

- `porting_order_phone_number_extensions` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_order_phone_number_extensions))

<a id="nestedatt--porting_order_phone_number_extensions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `porting_order_phone_number_extensions`

Read-Only:

- `activation_ranges` (Attributes List) Specifies the activation ranges for this porting phone number extension. The activation range must be within the extension range and should not overlap with other activation ranges. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_order_phone_number_extensions--activation_ranges))
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `extension_range` (Attributes) Specifies the extension range for this porting phone number extension. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_order_phone_number_extensions--extension_range))
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies this porting phone number extension.
- `porting_phone_number_id` (String) Identifies the porting phone number associated with this porting phone number extension.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--porting_order_phone_number_extensions--activation_ranges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `porting_order_phone_number_extensions.activation_ranges`

Read-Only:

- `end_at` (Number) Specifies the end of the activation range. It must be no more than the end of the extension range.
- `start_at` (Number) Specifies the start of the activation range. Must be greater or equal the start of the extension range.


<a id="nestedatt--porting_order_phone_number_extensions--extension_range"></a>
### Nested Schema for `porting_order_phone_number_extensions.extension_range`

Read-Only:

- `end_at` (Number) Specifies the end of the extension range for this porting phone number extension.
- `start_at` (Number) Specifies the start of the extension range for this porting phone number extension.
